nodes.label: Convex backend (cheerful-rat-350 / hearty-jay-608)
nodes.rationale: Every data function requires BOTH a valid session AND a trusted device; frontend and backend deploy independently; browser client version pinned in index.html should match package.json.

nodes.label: Resend email delivery
nodes.rationale: Free plan delivers only to the email the Resend account was created with, which is also the app's admin email; API key lives only in Convex env vars, never in the repo.

nodes.label: InstantDB → Convex migration (Aug 2026)
nodes.rationale: Everything exported with an admin token and imported 1:1 (verified by counts and bytes); one-off migration tools removed after cutover, InstantDB kept as fallback until ~2026-09-05.

nodes.label: ADMIN_EMAIL dual definition rule
nodes.rationale: The admin email is set in TWO places — index.html (ADMIN_EMAIL) and convex/lib.ts (ADMIN_EMAIL) — both must change together and both halves redeploy; S16 checks they match.
